integrity.description: The text file and HTML export were created through application interaction, not just 'echo' commands in a terminal.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific URLs provided in the prompt, not generic homepage links.
integrity.visual_evidence: The bookmark properties or the address bar showing the full paths (e.g., /math, /calculator, /programs/teachers).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The bookmarks must be placed in the 'Favorites Bar' specifically. The required URLs are: Khan Academy (khanacademy.org/math), Desmos (desmos.com/calculator), PhET (phet.colorado.edu), CommonLit (commonlit.org), Newsela (newsela.com), ReadWorks (readworks.org), NatGeo (education.nationalgeographic.org), NASA (nasa.gov/learning-resources), and Library of Congress (loc.gov/programs/teachers). The export path is /home/ga/Desktop/district_bookmarks.html and the instruction path is /home/ga/Desktop/bookmark_instructions.txt.
